profile.headline: Senior Front-End Engineer | Cross-Framework UI/UX Developer | React, JavaScript, Vue, Accessibility Champion
profile.summary: Senior Front-End Engineer with 20+ years of experience building and leading enterprise-level web applications across React.js, C#, PHP (TWIG), and modern design systems. Proven track record of optimizing UI/UX, mentoring cross-functional teams, and delivering scalable solutions. Professional experience and ongoing technical training equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, reinforced by certifications in Full Stack Development, React, QA Engineering, and AI-powered tools.

positions.title: Digital Accessibility Web Developer
positions.description:
• Reviewed and remediated HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code for accessibility compliance.  
• Collaborated with accessibility testers to implement sustainable, standards-based fixes.  
• Provided development guidance and hands-on coding support for agency teams.  
• Promoted accessibility-first web development culture for enhanced digital experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Jira · Front-End Development

company.name: State of Connecticut – Department of Administrative Services

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led front-end development initiatives for client-facing web applications and internal platforms, with minimal backend involvement.
• Designed, built, and implemented responsive user interfaces using modern frameworks, ensuring accessibility, performance, and cross-device compatibility.
• Collaborated with UX designers and product teams to translate design mockups into high-quality, maintainable front-end code.
• Participated in limited backend tasks, primarily focused on integrating APIs and supporting frontend data needs.
• Focused on growing front-end expertise while progressively expanding backend capabilities to transition into a full stack developer role.

positions.title: Sr. Interactive Designer
positions.description:
• Design and prototype interactive, visually polished user interfaces that enhance engagement and accessibility across all devices.
• Collaborate closely with product managers, UX researchers, and engineers to transform concepts into intuitive, user-centered designs.
• Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and motion-based interactions that effectively communicate design intent.
• Contribute to and maintain design systems, ensuring consistency in visual language and user experience across platforms.
• Apply usability testing, data insights, and feedback loops to continuously refine and evolve digital products.
• Stay informed on digital trends, design tools, and emerging technologies to drive innovation and elevate design standards.

positions.description:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver visually engaging and functional web interfaces aligned with brand identity and UX standards.

positions.title: Producer | Digital Media
positions.description:
• Oversee the creation, publishing, and maintenance of digital content across websites, ensuring accuracy, quality, and brand consistency.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including UX, design, marketing, and development to produce engaging and user-centered web experiences.
• Utilize CMS tools to manage content updates, optimize page layouts, and ensure mobile responsiveness and accessibility standards.
• Monitor web performance using analytics tools, identifying opportunities to improve user engagement and site functionality.
• Coordinate timelines, enforce content governance, and support digital campaign execution with a strong focus on deadlines and detail.

positions.title: Web Designer / Developer
positions.description: Designed, developed, and maintained the AnnaDavid.com website using WordPress with custom PHP implementations. Created a clean, user-friendly interface aligned with the brand’s voice and content strategy. Implemented responsive design, optimized site performance, and ensured cross-browser compatibility. Regularly updated content, managed plugins and themes, and performed ongoing maintenance to support scalability and usability. Collaborated directly with the client to translate evolving business needs into effective digital solutions.

positions.description: Led brand development, website design, and front-end development to support traffic growth, content strategy, and advertising revenue for four regional news websites: The Stamford Advocate, The Norwalk Hour, Greenwich Time, and an affiliated publication. Collaborated with editorial and advertising teams to introduce new digital products, optimize site performance, and align web strategy with business goals.
